title: Dihydrolycorine Attenuates Cardiac Fibrosis and Dysfunction by Downregulating Runx1 following Myocardial Infarction.
authors: Ni, Tingjuan; Huang, Xingxiao; Pan, Sunlei; Lu, Zhongqiu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物二氢石蒜碱通过下调Runx1改善心梗后心脏纤维化，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: In spite of early interventions to treat acute myocardial infarction (MI), the occurrence of adverse cardiac remodeling following heart failure due to acute MI remains a clinical challenge. Thus, there is an increasing demand for the development of novel therapeutic agents capable of inhibiting the development of pathological ventricular remodeling. RNA-seq data analysis of acute MI rat models from GEO revealed that Runx1 was the most differentially expressed MI-related gene. In this study, we demonstrated that increased Runx1 expression under pathological conditions results in decreased cardiac contractile function. We identified dihydrolycorine, an alkaloid lycorine, as a promising inhibitor of Runx1. Our results showed that treatment with this drug could prevent adverse cardiac remodeling, as indicated by the downregulation of fibrotic genes using western blotting (collagen I, TGFbeta, and p-smad3), downregulation of the apoptosis gene Bax, upregulation of the apoptosis gene Bcl-2, and improved cardiac functions, such as LVEF, LVSF, LVESD, and LVEDD. Additionally, dihydrolycorine treatment could rescue cardiomyocyte hypertrophy as demonstrated by wheat germ agglutinin staining, increased expression levels of the punctuate gap junction protein connexin 43, and decreased alpha-SMA expression, resulting in cardiomyocyte fibrosis in immunofluorescence staining. Molecular docking, binding modeling, and pull-down assays were used to identify potential dihydrolycorine-binding sites in Runx1. When Ad-sh-Runx1 was transfected into hypoxia-cardiomyocytes or injected into the hearts of MI rats, the cardioprotective effects of dihydrolycorine were abolished, and the normal electrophysiological activity of cardiomyocytes was disrupted. Taken together, the results of the present study indicate that dihydrolycorine may inhibit adverse cardiac remodeling after MI through the reduction of Runx1, suggesting that dihydrolycorine-mediated-Runx1 regulation might represent a novel therapeutic approach for adverse cardiac remodeling after MI.
abstract_zh: 尽管对急性心肌梗死（MI）进行了早期干预，但急性MI后心力衰竭引发的不良心脏重构仍然是临床挑战。因此，开发能够抑制病理性心室重构发展的新型治疗药物需求日益增加。对来自GEO的急性MI大鼠模型进行RNA-seq数据分析显示，Runx1是差异表达最显著的MI相关基因。在本研究中，我们证明病理条件下Runx1表达增加导致心脏收缩功能下降。我们鉴定出二氢石蒜碱（dihydrolycorine），一种生物碱石蒜碱，作为Runx1的有前景抑制剂。我们的结果表明，该药物治疗可预防不良心脏重构，具体表现为通过western blotting检测到纤维化基因（collagen I、TGFbeta和p-smad3）下调、凋亡基因Bax下调、凋亡基因Bcl-2上调，以及心脏功能改善，如LVEF、LVSF、LVESD和LVEDD。此外，二氢石蒜碱治疗可挽救心肌细胞肥大，如小麦胚芽凝集素染色所示，点状间隙连接蛋白connexin 43表达水平增加，以及alpha-SMA表达降低，从而在免疫荧光染色中减少心肌细胞纤维化。通过分子对接、结合模型和pull-down实验鉴定了Runx1中二氢石蒜碱的潜在结合位点。当Ad-sh-Runx1转染至缺氧心肌细胞或注射至MI大鼠心脏时，二氢石蒜碱的心脏保护作用被消除，心肌细胞的正常电生理活动被破坏。综上所述，本研究结果表明，二氢石蒜碱可能通过降低Runx1来抑制MI后的不良心脏重构，提示二氢石蒜碱介导的Runx1调控可能代表MI后不良心脏重构的新型治疗策略。
